description:
[FREE] Find a team and its id — the lookup every other team tool depends on.

Search by name prefix with `q` ("arse" finds Arsenal), or browse by first letter, or
list one kind of team. Each row carries the numeric id and the slug that get_team,
get_team_streaks, get_team_prediction, head_to_head and search_results take.

The database holds thousands of teams, so an unfiltered call returns the first 25 with
the full total beside them. Always pass `q` when you know the name.

Free: no key needed, and it costs a key holder nothing either.

letter.description: First letter A-Z to browse by, or "#" for names starting with a non-letter.

limit.description: How many teams to return. Default 25; the total number of matches is always reported.

q.description: Name prefix, matched against both the short and the full name. The fastest way to find one team.

type.description: Restrict to national teams or to clubs.

name: list_teams

country.description: The country a team or competition belongs to.

exists_now.description: False for a team that no longer exists.

full_name.description: Official or long name, when known.

id.description: Team id — the argument every team tool takes.

slug.description: URL slug; accepted anywhere an id is.

hint.description: Present only when rows were left out: how to narrow the call.

returned.description: How many rows are in data.

total.description: How many rows matched before the limit.

title: Find a team
